segments.subtask: The robot arm is positioned over the table, preparing to interact with the objects.
The robot arm moves towards the left side of the table where the non-food items are located.
The robot arm grasps a non-food item from the left side of the table.
The robot arm moves the non-food item towards the left basket.
The robot arm places the non-food item into the left basket.
The robot arm moves back towards the center of the table to pick up a food item.
The robot arm grasps a food item from the center of the table.
The robot arm moves the food item towards the right basket.
The robot arm places the food item into the right basket.
The robot arm retracts and prepares for the next action.
